title: Trump Just Made A New Announcement
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Escalation (Iran striking 19 vessels, Strait empty) contradicts Trump's oil reassurance; markets irrational and may ignore it.
Labor and PCE data this week drive odds (~66.6%) of a Fed rate hike Oct 28; a hike would be bearish.
Sixth US bank failure of 2026 tied to commercial real estate is a red flag.

calls.condition: Short only if a sell-off is confirmed; otherwise stay in cash and buy the dip
calls.reason: Markets incredibly overbought near all-time highs with pullback potential, but Trump reassurance keeps markets irrational.
calls.quote: There's a lot of pullback potential, which is a decent opportunity to short, but sentiment and direction are crucial

notes: Host says 'Happy Sunday'; events week has Sept jobs report Friday -> Sunday 2026-09-27 (listing 09-28).
